items.title: 31.2 Material science mein zehreelapan aur recycling (Roman Urdu)

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Kitab is heading ke foran baad 31.2.1 shuru karti hai. Jo materials hamari zindagi aasan banate hain woh nuqsan bhi de sakte hain. Is hisse mein parhenge: 31.2.1 mein materials ki toxicity (zehreelapan), 31.2.2 mein do bare toxic materials, heavy metals aur plastics, aur 31.2.3 mein recycling, jo resources aur energy bachati hai lekin us ki apni mushkilat (challenges) hain.

blocks.prompt: Is hisse mein kin do bare toxic materials ki baat hai?
blocks.explanation: Heavy metals (lead, mercury, cadmium) aur plastics.
